articles.headline: Sales tax gets new enforcement structure to cut collection gap
articles.summary: AI summary: The government is undoing the 2009 merger of sales tax and income tax functions in the Inland Revenue Service, creating a dedicated sales tax and federal excise wing with separate zones starting at Large Taxpayer Offices on December 1. Officials told Dawn sales tax makes up about Rs3.4 trillion of a Rs6.2 trillion revenue gap, and separation is meant to sharpen accountability.
